records.label: CFG_6
records.bytes: fe f2 ab c4 aa f1 df df bb af df df
records.note: 12-byte trailer written unconditionally with the rate: {DINAFE, DINAF2, DINAAB, 0xc4, DINAAA, DINAF1, DINADF, DINADF, 0xBB, 0xAF, DINADF, DINADF}. In the mlsdk lineage CFG_6 is the 1-byte FIFO-interrupt point (fe = interrupt on packet).
